name: EvalMi-50K
description: Recent breakthroughs in large multimodal models (LMMs) have significantly advanced both text-to-image (T2I) generation and image-to-text (I2T) interpretation. However, many generated images still suffer from issues related to perceptual quality and text-image alignment. Given the high cost and inefficiency of manual evaluation, an automatic metric that aligns with human preferences is desirable. To this end, we present EvalMi-50K, a comprehensive dataset and benchmark for evaluating large-multimodal image generation, which features (i) comprehensive tasks, encompassing 2,100 extensive prompts across 20 fine-grained task dimensions, and (ii) large-scale human-preference annotations, including 100K mean-opinion scores (MOSs) and 50K question-answering (QA) pairs annotated on 50,400 images generated from 24 T2I models. evaluation_method: correlation with human preference/MOS and QA-based accuracy
reputation: A very recent benchmark for automatic evaluation of text-to-image generation quality and alignment, with substantial human annotations but limited community adoption so far.
notes: Primarily a metric-evaluation benchmark rather than a direct generation benchmark; results depend on agreement with human MOS and QA annotations, and reported scores may not be directly comparable across sub-tasks.
